Which form Big claims Unknowns Its story What changed Next What people report What people report Reports What Creatine does in the body Creatine is absorbed intact and pumped into muscle cells by a dedicated transporter. Inside, an enzyme sticks a phosphate onto it, making a small rechargeable battery. During a maximal effort the battery hands its phosphate to spent energy molecules, keeping the cell going for several seconds longer than it otherwise would. Why people take it. Taken for strength and power output in short, hard efforts What happened in people Twelve weeks of training with creatine produced greater fat-free mass, bench press, squat and fibre cross-sectional area than training with placebo in trained men ✎ Written into the record, not signed off. Which form Big claims Unknowns Its story What changed Next What people report What people report Reports What Semaglutide does in the body After a meal your gut releases a hormone called GLP-1 that tells the brain you have had enough. Natural GLP-1 is destroyed within minutes. Semaglutide is a rebuilt version with a fatty tail that clips onto albumin, the taxi protein of the blood, so one injection lasts a week. Why people take it. Used for type 2 diabetes, obesity, and related heart or kidney risk. What happened in people In 1,961 adults, average weight fell about 15%, compared with about 2% after a dummy treatment. ✓ Reviewed first-read answer. Which form Big claims Unknowns Its story What changed Next What people report What people report Reports What Inclisiran does in the body Your liver pulls cholesterol out of the blood using catchers on its surface called LDL receptors. A protein named PCSK9 grabs those catchers and drags them off to be destroyed, so you end up with fewer of them. Inclisiran is a short piece of RNA with a sugar tag that only liver cells recognise; once inside, it hands the liver a template for shredding its own PCSK9 instructions. Why people take it. Used with diet and exercise to lower LDL, often called “bad” cholesterol. What happened in people After about 17 months, two large studies found that LDL fell by about half on average compared with look-alike injections containing no inclisiran. ✓ Reviewed first-read answer.
